import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Merge two feeds (CRM and web) with SOURCE PRECEDENCE golden-record deduplication.
    CRM (source rank 1) beats web (source rank 2) regardless of recency.
    Within same source, newer records win. Email breaks ties deterministically.
    """
    crm_feed = inputs["crm_feed"].copy()
    web_feed = inputs["web_feed"].copy()

    # Step 1: Create STG_COMBINED with UNION ALL and source ranking
    crm_feed["src_rank"] = 1
    web_feed["src_rank"] = 2

    # Combine both feeds
    stg_combined = pd.concat([crm_feed, web_feed], ignore_index=True)

    # Step 2: Apply windowed deduplication with deterministic ordering
    # ORDER BY: src_rank ASC (CRM wins), updated_at DESC (newer wins), email ASC (deterministic tie-break)
    stg_sorted = stg_combined.sort_values(
        by=["customer_id", "src_rank", "updated_at", "email"],
        ascending=[True, True, False, True],
        na_position="last",
        kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Rank within each customer_id group after sorting
    stg_sorted["rn"] = stg_sorted.groupby("customer_id", sort=False).cumcount() + 1

    # Keep only the first record per customer_id (rn = 1)
    golden = stg_sorted[stg_sorted["rn"] == 1].copy()

    # Select only the output columns (drop src_rank and rn)
    golden = golden[["customer_id", "email", "updated_at"]].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"golden": golden}
